# Skill: Product discovery

## Purpose

Define what Ada should do before choosing how to implement it.

## Rules

- Run the interview in `docs/prompts/product-discovery-interview-prompt.md` one question at a time.
- Separate user needs from proposed technologies.
- Capture concrete scenarios before feature labels.
- Classify features as MVP, v1, later, nice-to-have, or explicitly out-of-scope.
- Record unknowns instead of inventing answers.
- Do not select frameworks during discovery; capture the constraints and evaluation criteria they must satisfy.
- End with a concise English discovery artifact suitable for `docs/product/` and `docs/research/`.

## Exit criteria

Discovery is sufficient for architecture work when the MVP has a coherent end-to-end user journey, the most sensitive data/actions are known, and unresolved technology choices have explicit decision criteria.
